companies.EcoMatcher: BLOCK71 Bandung-listed Hong Kong-headquartered B-Corp (founded 2016 by Bas Fransen) operating a blockchain-tracked tree-planting / forest-management platform — TreeCorder data-capture app, TreeManager cloud system, Verra/Gold Standard carbon-certified TREES+ projects (partnership with VNV Advisory). Corporate customers include Grab and Procter & Gamble; ~50,000 customers globally. Drop generic 'eco' / matching-engine mentions.
companies.Flexii: BLOCK71 Singapore-resident startup. Limited public-English information beyond the directory listing — drop unrelated 'Flexi' / 'Flexii' brand mentions (Flexi loans, Flexi-Coil, etc.) unless the article explicitly references this BLOCK71 SG entity.
companies.Renaissance: The Hangar (NUS Enterprise)-resident Singapore startup. CRITICAL: 'Renaissance' is extremely generic (Renaissance Technologies hedge fund, Renaissance Re insurance, Renaissance Hotels, Renaissance learning); drop almost all 'Renaissance' news unless the article explicitly references the BLOCK71 / NUS Hangar entity.
companies.RoamAssist: NUS GRIP-incubated Singapore deep-tech startup. Drop unrelated companies sharing the same name.
companies.Skuling: BLOCK71 Yogyakarta-resident Indonesian edutech startup building a gamified web learning platform — leaderboards, social discussion, performance analytics — targeting Indonesian primary/secondary education accessibility and engagement gaps. ~110,000 users across 502 of 514 Indonesian cities. Founded by Yudha Pratama Situmorang (Boston University Questrom MBA'24); 2024 Poets & Quants Most Disruptive MBA Startup. Drop generic 'schooling' / education-tech mentions.

llm_fetch_required.hint: Webflow CMS listing under div.collection-list-wrapper-2.w-dyn-list. Each item is a div.div-block-78 containing a category label in div.category, a headline in div.text-block-27 (treat as the title), and a date as plain text in div.text-block-29 (e.g. 'April 28, 2026'). About 6 items shown in reverse chronological order. Resolve relative item links against https://www.ailytics.ai/.
llm_fetch_required.label: news

llm_fetch_required.hint: Cellivate 'Recognition' page lists press features and awards. Each article entry is a clickable row with a date at the top-left (e.g. 'May 18, 2023'), then headline text, then publication attribution ('Published by TechNode Global', etc.). Resolve relative links against https://www.cellivatetech.com/.
llm_fetch_required.label: press

llm_fetch_required.hint: Craft Health 'Latest News' page is a chronological press/achievements timeline organised by year and month headers (e.g. '2021', then 'January 2021'). Each entry is a bullet line of plain text describing a media mention or award, often with an inline '[<Read_More>]' or named hyperlink to an external article. Dates come from the month/year section headings, not per-item. Resolve relative links against https://www.crafthealth.me/.
llm_fetch_required.label: news

llm_fetch_required.hint: WordPress (Yoast SEO) press-release page on hicuramedical.com. Each item is a row containing a publisher logo/thumbnail, a bolded headline (in <strong> tags rather than h2/h3), a short description, and a 'View Article' link to an external publisher URL. No explicit per-item date elements; dates only appear inline within some headlines (e.g. '2023'). Resolve relative links against https://hicuramedical.com/.
llm_fetch_required.label: press

llm_fetch_required.hint: Card-based blog listing on insightic.io. Each card contains a thumbnail image (from /img/), a category badge ('insightic research', 'community resource', 'new partnership'), a clickable headline that links to the individual post URL, and a publication date in 'Day Mon DD YYYY' format (e.g. 'Tue Oct 31 2023') displayed below the headline. Resolve relative links against https://insightic.io/.
llm_fetch_required.label: blog

llm_fetch_required.hint: Card-based press listing for Lalia Pte Ltd (Singapore). Each card has a thumbnail image, an <h3> headline (often in Japanese), a secondary line with the source URL, and a publication date in 'YYYY/MM/DD' format below it. Each card wraps in an <a> tag linking to the full article (often external publishers). Resolve relative links against https://read.lalia.com.sg/.
llm_fetch_required.label: press

llm_fetch_required.hint: News listing is vertically-stacked article cards; each card has a headline, publication date, brief description, and 'Read more' link. Relative links resolve against https://www.neumaterials.com/.
llm_fetch_required.label: newsroom

llm_fetch_required.hint: Seamless XR (NUS spin-off) news page. Each entry is a link block: headline text directly followed by the publication date in 'Mon DD, YYYY' format (e.g. 'Nov 30, 2025'). No dedicated <article> tag; items appear as anchor links with the date bundled inline after the title. A 'Load More' button loads additional items. Resolve relative links against https://www.seamless.sg.
llm_fetch_required.label: news

llm_fetch_required.hint: Seamless XR blog index. Each post is a link element with the headline followed by the date in 'Mon DD, YYYY' format and a path like /blog/<slug>. About 11 entries listed, dated through Mar 2026. Resolve relative links against https://www.seamless.sg.
llm_fetch_required.label: blog

llm_fetch_required.hint: SENSORI Healthcare news listing. Each item is an anchor (<a>) wrapping the entry with the headline rendered as an <h4> (e.g. 'SENSORI Healthcare Wins Third Prize at Two Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competitions') and the date below in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. '2025-12-03'). Items are tagged 'News' and ordered newest-first. Resolve relative links against https://www.sensorihealthcare.com.
llm_fetch_required.label: news

llm_fetch_required.hint: Wix-hosted media/press listing for SINGROW (NUS agritech spin-off). Items are <div> grid tiles (no semantic <article>); each tile has the headline in <h4>, the publication date in <h4> below the title in 'DD Month YYYY' format, then a 'By <Publication Name>' attribution and a 'Read More' link. About 25+ external news items aggregated, newest-first. Resolve relative links against https://www.singrow.com.
llm_fetch_required.label: media

llm_fetch_required.hint: Soynergy WordPress news category listing. Each post is a <div> block with a featured image, headline in <h2> link, and the publication date below in 'Month Day, Year' format (e.g. 'August 27, 2018'); a 'News' tag appears above the headline and a 'READ MORE' link follows. Note: archive is small and stale (last post 2018). Resolve relative links against https://www.soynergy.com.
llm_fetch_required.label: news

llm_fetch_required.hint: Blog listing on Spacejot's web app. Each post is rendered with an h3 headline that links to /blog/<slug>, with the publication date (e.g. 'Jul 06, 2024') displayed adjacent to the title. Resolve relative links against https://www.spacejot.app/.
llm_fetch_required.label: blog
